mechanism: Bumetanide may increase atorvastatin levels through competition for renal clearance and potential CYP3A4 modulation, while loop diuretics increase myopathy risk in statin users through electrolyte depletion and muscle vulnerability.
action: Monitor for statin myopathy symptoms (muscle pain, weakness); maintain electrolyte balance, especially potassium; consider baseline and periodic creatine kinase if high-risk features present.
